name: claude-remote
description: Continue this machine's Claude Code conversations from a phone: the official Remote Control where the CLI serves it, and a self-hosted end-to-end encrypted relay (claude-remote-server) everywhere else. One QR per PC, every window of it, phones paired by scan, sealed frames the relay cannot read. Works in VS Code and Git Graph Studio.

enumDescriptions: The official Remote Control where the CLI reports it available; the self-hosted relay otherwise (and always for third-party model providers)
Only the official Remote Control; the panel shows the CLI's own reason when it is unavailable
Only the self-hosted relay (works with any model provider)
claudeRemote.mode.description: How the phone reaches this machine's Claude Code conversations.

claudeRemote.serverUrl.description: The self-hosted relay (claude-remote-server) this PC registers on, e.g. https://relay.example.com:8787. Every window of this PC shares its user id and pairing QR.

claudeRemote.autoConnect.description: Connect to the relay when the window opens (when an address is configured).

enumDescriptions: Do not mirror official Remote Control sessions to the relay
Mirror a conversation while the CLI reports its Remote Control connected (read-only)
Mirror the conversation stream to the relay whether or not official Remote Control is on
claudeRemote.mirrorOfficial.description: A read-only copy of the official Remote Control's own stream, delivered to the self-hosted relay so its phone app shows the same conversation. The official switch itself is never touched.

claudeRemote.mirrorControl.description: Let the self-hosted phone drive a mirrored conversation. Instructions travel the desktop tab's own UI (the same buttons a user at the keyboard could press), so the official client sees only the local user.

claudeRemote.mirrorConnectUrl.description: Include the official Remote Control connectUrl in the mirrored stream (it is a live key into the official session — off by default).

claudeRemote.official.allSessions.description: Claude's own `remoteControlAtStartup` — Remote Control on for every new conversation (claude.ai login and first-party models only).

enumDescriptions: Drive the conversation's own Claude Code tab (Git Graph Studio); falls back to the self-hosted SDK runner where the host cannot
Never drive the desktop tabs: prompts run through this window's own claude CLI child
claudeRemote.backend.description: How a phone prompt runs on this desktop.

enumDescriptions: Open the conversation's Claude Code tab when an out-of-tab turn starts, and reload it when the turn ends so it shows the phone's turn and continues from it
Only open (or reveal) the tab when an out-of-tab turn starts
claudeRemote.desktopTab.description: What an out-of-tab phone turn does to the conversation's Claude Code tab.
